title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant
Bristol (hybrid Working - 2 days pw in office)
Up to 35,000 + excellent Benefits
Are you a highly organised Executive Assistant with strong analytical and presentation skills? Do you enjoy working closely with senior leaders, transforming complex information into meaningful insights, and helping drive business performance?
We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded Executive Assistant to support the senior leadership team within a busy, flexible business.
This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in enabling strategic decision-making while gaining exposure to senior stakeholders across multiple business functions.
The Role
As Executive Assistant, you will provide comprehensive support to senior leaders, ensuring priorities, schedules and strategic activities are managed effectively.
Beyond traditional executive support, you will be responsible for analysing business data, producing executive-level reports, and creating impactful presentations that influence business decisions.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, has exceptional communication skills, and thrives in a collaborative environment.
Key Responsibilities
- Provide proactive executive support, including diary management, scheduling and coordination of key business priorities.
- Produce executive-level reports, dashboards and performance packs by analysing business data and identifying key trends.
- Convert complex data and business information into visually engaging PowerPoint presentations for leadership audiences.
- Create board-ready presentations, briefing papers and decision-support materials for senior stakeholders.
- Coordinate leadership meetings, ensuring agendas, actions, decisions and follow-up activities are effectively managed.
- Partner with Finance, Operations and People teams to gather, validate and interpret business data.
- Drive continuous improvements by streamlining reporting processes, introducing automation and enhancing data quality.
- Act as a trusted partner to the leadership team, providing the organisation, insight and support needed to facilitate informed decision-making.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Senior Administrator or Business Support professional.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and present business data effectively.
- Advanced PowerPoint skills and experience creating presentations for senior leadership audiences.
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
- High levels of attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
- Experience working with reporting tools, dashboards or business performance data would be advantageous.
- A proactive mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.

What's On Offer?
- Salary of up to 35,000
- Hybrid working model - 2 days pw in the office
- Comprehensive benefits package
- Exposure to senior leadership and strategic business initiatives
- Opportunities for professional development and career progression
- Collaborative and supportive working environment

If you're looking for an opportunity where you can combine executive support, business insight and stakeholder engagement to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply today to find out more.

If you receive suspicious outreach claiming to be from us, please contact us via the ManpowerGroup website.

title: Claims Handler
description:
Job Title: Claims Handler

Location: Bristol (Hybrid - 3 days per week in the office)

Salary: Up to £35,000

Benefits: Hybrid working, professional qualification support (CII), long-term progression opportunities

About the Company:

This is an opportunity to join a well-established and growing specialist insurer with a strong reputation across financial lines, construction, accident & health, and affinity products. Backed by a major international parent group, the business combines the stability and support of a global insurer with the close-knit culture of a smaller regional team. With excellent staff retention and ambitious growth plans over the next few years, the business offers genuine long-term career development within a collaborative environment.

Role Summary:

This is an opportunity to join a busy claims function and manage insurance claims from first notification through to settlement or resolution.

You'll take ownership of claim outcomes, work closely with customers, brokers, adjusters and suppliers, and build broader technical exposure across coverage, liability, reserving and claims decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage claims from FNOL through to resolution: Build end-to-end claims experience while taking ownership of outcomes
- Review policy terms, coverage and claim documentation: Develop stronger technical judgement around coverage and liability decisions
- Communicate with customers and brokers: Build trusted relationships while providing clear and professional claims updates
- Liaise with TPAs, adjusters and suppliers: Gain exposure to the wider claims process and external stakeholders
- Maintain accurate, audit-ready claim files: Strengthen your understanding of regulatory, data and compliance requirements
- Monitor reserves, indemnity spend and settlement strategy: Develop commercial awareness and intelligent claims decision-making

Requirements:
- Experience or technical knowledge of insurance claims, including the claims lifecycle from FNOL through to settlement
- Understanding of policy wordings, coverage principles and liability assessment, with familiarity with Civil Procedure Rules and the litigation process
- Awareness of FCA requirements, Consumer Duty, data protection and fair customer outcomes
- Confident communication, organisation and claims-system skills, with the ability to manage workloads and escalate complex matters appropriately

If this role isn't quite right, it's still worth speaking to one of our specialist team - we may be working on something that hasn't hit the market yet.

Related Job Titles: Claims Advisor, Claims Technician, Claims Adjuster, Claims Specialist, Insurance Claims Handler

title: IT Co-ordinator
description:
We have an exciting opportunity to join our IT here at Framatome UK!

Energise Your Career with Framatome UK - Powering a Safer, Smarter Nuclear Future

We are currently seeking a IT Co-ordinator to join our team in Avonmouth to support with the successful planning, governance, delivery and continuous improvement of IT projects and initiatives.

Working across business and technology teams, the IT Co-ordinator ensures projects are delivered efficiently, transparently and in line with business objectives and IT strategy.

What will you be doing?

Project Coordination & Delivery
- Coordinating the planning, execution, and monitoring of IT projects and work streams
- Support Project Managers and IT leadership in managing project schedules, milestones, deliverables and dependencies
- Tracking project progress and ensure timely completion of agreed actions
- Maintain project documentation, including project plans, RAID logs, status reports and governance artefacts
- Facilitating project meetings, workshops, and steering committees, documenting actions and decisions
- Monitoring project risks, issues and changes, escalating where needed
- Supporting resource planning and capacity management activities across the IT portfolio

Delivery Framework & Governance
- Champion adherence to IT project delivery methodologies, governance and best practice
- Ensuring projects comply with established delivery frameworks, stage gates and approval processes
- Maintaining governance documentation, templates, reporting standards and project controls
- Supporting portfolio reporting by consolidating project status updates, KPIs, milestones and delivery metrics
- Driving continuous improvement of project management processes and delivery governance
- Assisting in the development and implementation of PMO and project governance frameworks
- Supporting audit, compliance and regulatory requirements relating to project delivery activities

Stakeholder Management
- Building strong working relationships with different stakeholders
- Central point of coordination between project teams, users, vendors, and leadership
- Informing stakeholders of progress, risks, issues, and decisions
- Facilitating effective communication across departments and organisational levels
- Support stakeholder engagement activities, including requirements gathering, impact assessments and change planning
- Managing meetings schedules and communication plans

Vendor & Third-Party Coordination
- Coordinating activities with technology vendors and external service providers
- Monitoring supplier deliverables against agreed timelines and requirements
- Supporting contract, service review and performance tracking activities where required
- Escalating supplier issues and risks to project and IT leadership teams

Reporting & Administration
- Producing regular project status reports and executive summaries
- Maintaining project repositories and document management systems
- Ensuring accuracy and completeness of project records and governance documentation
- Supporting budget tracking, purchase requests and project financial reporting where required
- Providing administrative support to project boards and governance forums

What are we looking for?

Essential
- Experience coordinating IT projects, programmes, or technology initiatives and supporting project governance and delivery frameworks
- Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Hybrid)
- Excellent stakeholder management
- Communication skills
- Strong organisational and planning abilities
- Attention to detail
- Experience managing risks, issues, actions, and dependencies
- Advanced knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and SharePoint
- Prioritise in a fast-paced environment

Desirable
- Experience within a PMO or IT delivery function
- Knowledge of ITIL practices and service management processes
- Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday. com, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project or COEDM3
- Professional certifications such as:
- PRINCE2 Foundation/Practitioner
- Agile Foundation or Scrum certification
- PMQ, PMP, or equivalent
- ITIL Foundation

Key Competencies
- Project Coordination
- Stakeholder Management
- Governance & Compliance
- Planning & Organisation
- Communication & Influencing
- Risk & Issue Management
- Continuous Improvement
- Collaboration & Teamwork
- Problem Solving
- Attention to Detail

Work pattern: Hybrid

Benefits we offer:
- 25 daysannual leave per year rising by 1 day for every 2 years worked (max 30 days) + Bank Holidays
- 8% employer pension contribution with employee 1% contribution (salary sacrifice)
- Employee assistance programme (EAP)

Our benefits package also includes Individual and family private health care, Dental insurance - individual cover, Cashplan - Level 2 cover - individual and family cover, Life assurance (4x salary), Income Protection, Professional Body Membership, Tusker Electric car scheme (salary sacrifice), Cycle to Work scheme (salary sacrifice), Babbel - learn a new language and Generous family leave.

At Framatome we are a global leader in nuclear energy, recognised for delivering innovative, value-added technologies that design, build, maintain, and advance the world's nuclear fleet. With 22,000 employees in over 70 locations worldwide, we provide components, fuel, and control systems for nuclear power plants, along with a full suite of reactor services - all focused on improving safety, performance, and sustainability.

Backed by EDF Group (80.5%) and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (19.5%), we're driving the future of clean energy. Here in the UK, our team is now over 500 strong - and growing. As we expand our service offerings across the UK nuclear industry, we're aiming continuing our growth journey.

Now's your chance to join a company that's shaping the energy transition - where your expertise will matter, your growth will be supported, and your work will help power generations to come.

title: Sales and Partnerships Coordinator

description:
Sales and Partnerships Coordinator

We are seeking a proactive Sales and Partnerships Coordinator to generate new opportunities, build relationships and grow demand for consultancy and training services.

Salary: £30,559 to £32,654 FTE
Hours: 22.5 hours per week, flexibly across three or more days
Location: Bristol, with flexible/remote working and some office attendance required
Contract: Permanent
Closing date: Midday, Monday 5 October 2026
Interviews: Thursday 15 October 2026

About the role

This is an exciting opportunity to join a small, purpose-led organisation and play an important role in the growth and sustainability of its consultancy and training services.

Working within The Peer Partnership, a specialist peer support service, you will focus on generating new business, developing relationships with potential clients and key decision-makers, and increasing demand for The Peer Partnership's services, which include training, consultancy and service delivery.

The Peer Partnership helps organisations develop effective, safe and user-led peer support services for people living with long-term physical and mental health conditions and people with protected characteristics.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Identifying and developing new sales opportunities across the UK
- Building strong relationships with potential clients, commissioners, stakeholders and decision-makers
- Generating and converting leads for training, consultancy and service delivery
- Developing approaches to increase awareness and demand for The Peer Partnership's services
- Promoting the value and impact of peer support
- Monitoring sales and income generation activity and using results to continually improve approaches
- Supporting the ongoing growth and financial sustainability of the service

About you

You will be proactive, ambitious and creative, with experience of generating new business, sales or developing income streams.

An excellent communicator and relationship builder, you will be comfortable engaging influential stakeholders and decision-makers and turning opportunities into new business.

You will have:
- Experience in sales, income generation, business development or a related area
- A track record of developing leads and securing new business
- Strong relationship-building and communication skills
- The confidence to engage commissioners and senior stakeholders
- A commercial mindset combined with a commitment to delivering an excellent customer experience
- The ability to monitor results, identify what is working and adapt your approach
- An interest in peer support and improving outcomes for people experiencing challenging circumstances

You do not necessarily need previous charity sector experience, but you will need to share the organisation's values of respect, empowerment and inclusion.

About the organisation

You will be joining a small charity with a 30-year history of providing high-quality support services.

Its specialist peer support service, The Peer Partnership, works with people living with long-term health conditions and organisations to develop effective, safe and user-led peer support services. Through consultancy, training and service development, it shares expertise and best practice to help organisations establish and strengthen peer support.

Benefits include 26 days' holiday plus bank holidays pro rata, a 6% pension contribution, ongoing training and professional development, regular one-to-one supervision, flexible working options and a Cycle to Work scheme.

The organisation is committed to reducing inequity, valuing diversity and enabling inclusion and welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds with the appropriate skills to apply.

Other roles you may have experience of could include: Lead Generator, Sales Coordinator, Sales Executive, Income Generation Coordinator, Business Development Executive, Partnerships Coordinator, Client Development Coordinator, Sales and Partnerships Officer or Business Development Coordinator.

Please note this role is advertised by the recruitment agency acting for the client, Not For Profit People.

title: Venue Finder & Sales Co-ordinator
description:
Venue Finder & Sales Co-ordinator

In Any Event UK

Are you organised, confident on the phone and great with people? Do you enjoy researching brilliant venues, negotiating a great deal and turning an initial enquiry into a happy client?

In Any Event UK is looking for an enthusiastic Venue Finder & Sales Co-ordinator to join our friendly and busy events team.

This is a varied role combining venue finding, client relationship management, sales and event support. No two days are quite the same, so we're looking for someone who enjoys variety, takes ownership of their work and has the confidence to make things happen.

About In Any Event

In Any Event is an established, independent event management and venue finding agency. We work with a wide variety of clients to deliver everything from conferences and exhibitions to product launches, corporate events and special experiences.

Our clients are at the heart of everything we do. We're known for our personal approach, attention to detail and commitment to finding the right solution rather than simply the easiest one.

The Role

A key part of the position will be managing venue finding enquiries from initial brief through to confirmation.

You'll speak directly with clients to understand exactly what they're looking for, research suitable venues, check availability, negotiate rates and added value, and present the best options back to the client in a professional and engaging way.

You'll be responsible for keeping clients updated throughout the process and making sure every enquiry is managed accurately and efficiently.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing venue finding enquiries from start to finish
- Taking detailed client briefs and understanding their event requirements
- Researching and recommending suitable venues
- Contacting venues to check availability and place provisional holds
- Negotiating rates and added value on behalf of our clients
- Producing professional, client-facing venue proposals
- Keeping clients regularly updated throughout their search
- Maintaining accurate information within our bespoke enquiry and CRM systems
- Following up with clients after their events
- Managing venue-related administration, client recharges and credit arrangements
- Sales & Business Development

Sales is an important part of this position.

We're looking for someone who is comfortable picking up the phone, starting conversations and helping us develop new business.

You will:
- Make regular outbound sales calls to prospective clients
- Research potential new clients and opportunities
- Work towards a target of at least 20 sales calls per week
- Generate a target of 4 new business appointments per month
- Build and maintain relationships with existing and prospective clients
- Support promotions, special offers and client communications
- Attend exhibitions and networking opportunities when required

You don't need to be a pushy salesperson. We're looking for someone who is confident, personable, professional and genuinely enjoys talking to people and building relationships.

Event Support

You'll also become part of our wider events team, giving you the opportunity to get involved in the events themselves.

This may include:
- Supporting Event Managers with event administration and planning
- Assisting with delegate registration
- Working with our Eazybook registration system
- Producing reports and information for clients
- Helping with a variety of event tasks as required
- Attending and supporting events onsite, including occasional evenings and weekends

Who Are We Looking For?

We're looking for someone who is:

Enthusiastic and motivated

Naturally organised with excellent attention to detail

Confident speaking to clients and suppliers

Comfortable making outbound sales calls

Customer focused and committed to delivering excellent service

A strong communicator, both verbally and in writing

Able to manage multiple enquiries and deadlines

A good negotiator

Happy working independently while also being a real team player

Proactive and willing to take ownership

Positive, with a genuine "can do" attitude

Experience in venues, hospitality and the events industry

Previous experience within events, hotels, hospitality, venue finding, sales or customer service would be an advantage, but just as important to us is finding someone with the right attitude, personality and enthusiasm to learn.

Why Join In Any Event?

This is a great opportunity for someone who wants a role with genuine variety and the chance to develop within the events industry.

You'll work alongside an experienced events team, gain exposure to a wide range of clients, venues and events, and have the opportunity to see projects progress from the first enquiry right through to the event itself.

We're a close-knit team where everyone's contribution matters, and we're looking for someone who wants to become a real part of the business rather than simply fill a role.

Interested?

We'd love to hear from you.

title: Receptionist
description: Hanham Health (Almondsbury Surgery) is seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Receptionist/Administrator to join our friendly and supportive team. This is an excellent opportunity for an individual with strong communication and organisational skills who enjoys working in a patient-facing environment and providing excellent customer service. As the first point of contact for patients, visitors and healthcare professionals, you will play a vital role in ensuring patients receive a professional, welcoming and efficient service, both face-to-face and over the telephone. This role is predominantly based at ourAlmondsbury Surgery, although there may be occasions when you will be required to work from our Pilning Surgery. As a Receptionist/Administrator, you will provide a professional, efficient and welcoming service to patients, visitors and healthcare professionals. As a first point of contact for the practice, you will ensure enquiries are handled appropriately, sensitively and confidentially. The role combines reception & administrative responsibilities to support the smooth running of the practice and delivery of high-quality patient care. Duties include greeting patients, answering telephone calls, responding to enquiries and directing patients to the appropriate clinician or service. You will manage appointment requests and bookings received in person, by telephone and through online systems, including Anima. You will process patient requests via EMIS, NHS Mail and other digital platforms, register new patients and maintain accurate patient records in line with GDPR and practice policies. Administrative duties include scanning, filing and processing correspondence, updating patient records and supporting the wider practice team with routine tasks. The successful candidate will have excellent communication and customer service skills, be organised and reliable, and work effectively in a busy environment. You will demonstrate a positive, flexible and patient-focused approach while maintaining confidentiality at all times. You will work collaboratively with colleagues and undertake any reasonable duties appropriate to the role to support the delivery of safe and effective healthcare services. Job Purpose To provide an efficient, professional and friendly reception and administrative service to patients, visitors and staff. The post holder will act as a first point of contact for the practice, ensuring that patients receive a high standard of customer service and support. The role requires confidentiality, accuracy, effective communication skills and the ability to work within a busy primary care environment. Key Responsibilities Reception Duties Welcome patients and visitors in a courteous and professional manner. Manage patient enquiries both face-to-face and over the telephone. Signpost patients to the most appropriate service, clinician or member of the team. Manage appointment requests and bookings using practice systems and procedures. Inform patients of practice processes and available services. Ensure reception areas remain tidy, organised and welcoming. Telephone and Digital Services Answer incoming calls promptly and professionally. Respond to patient enquiries and requests in accordance with practice policies. Process requests received through Anima, NHS Mail, EMIS and other approved communication systems. Accurately record messages and ensure appropriate follow-up action is taken. Escalate urgent matters to the appropriate clinician or manager. Administrative Duties Register new patients and complete relevant documentation. Update and maintain patient records, ensuring information is accurate and current. Scan, file and retrieve documents as required. Process incoming and outgoing correspondence promptly. Support clinical and non-clinical teams with administrative tasks. Prepare letters, documents and reports when requested. Undertake photocopying, scanning and document management duties. Assist with processing test results in accordance with practice procedures. Support monitoring of daily administrative tasks to ensure completion within required timescales. Information Governance and Confidentiality Maintain strict confidentiality of patient and practice information at all times. Adhere to GDPR, NHS confidentiality requirements and practice policies. Ensure patient records are handled securely and accurately. Report any information governance concerns to management. Communication and Team Working Develop and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and external agencies. Communicate clearly and sensitively with patients, carers and healthcare professionals. Participate in team meetings, training and development activities. Contribute positively to a supportive and collaborative working environment. Quality and Safety Follow all practice policies, procedures and protocols. Maintain awareness of safeguarding, health and safety, infection control and equality and diversity requirements. Report incidents, risks or concerns through appropriate channels. Participate in service improvement initiatives where required. General Responsibilities Demonstrate flexibility to support the needs of the practice. Attend mandatory training and complete required updates. Maintain a professional appearance and conduct at all times. Undertake any other reasonable duties commensurate with the role and grade. Be prepared to work at either Pilning Surgery or Almondsbury Surgery as required by the needs of the service.
